invariants.rule: No consequential action is authorized merely by UI access, job title or model recommendation.
invariants.proof: tests/node/kernel.test.mjs — scoped grants, delegation bounds, parent revocation, stop/hold supremacy

invariants.rule: Database/projection state does not outrank lawful reality or qualifying evidence.
invariants.proof: tests/node/sw0-04.test.mjs + tests/node/sw0-10.test.mjs — contextual evidence remains authoritative and operational projections are explicitly disposable/rebuildable

invariants.rule: Forecast, interest and history cannot silently become committed demand.
invariants.proof: tests/node/sw0-05.test.mjs — forecast, interest and request remain DemandSignal records; commitment requires a distinct explicit checkout operation

invariants.rule: No payment, allocation or fulfillment obligation is created without an authorized event/relationship.
invariants.proof: tests/node/sw0-05.test.mjs + tests/node/sw0-07b.test.mjs — purchase Obligation requires active membership and a verifiably ACCEPTED command/event reference

invariants.rule: Capability, capacity, offer, availability and owned inventory remain distinct.
invariants.proof: tests/node/sw0-11.test.mjs — supply facts carry explicit non-interchangeable facets instead of collapsing capacity/offer/availability/ownership

invariants.rule: GROW/CONTRACT/BUY/PROCESS/IMPORT decisions compare equivalent obligations; ABSTAIN remains valid.
invariants.proof: tests/node/sw0-11.test.mjs — sourcing alternatives require equivalent spec/quantity/place/time/currency scope and ABSTAIN is first-class

invariants.rule: Physical quantity creation/destruction requires traceable event, transformation or measured variance.
invariants.proof: tests/node/sw0-11.test.mjs — physical transformations require evidence and reconcile input quantity to output plus explicit loss

invariants.rule: Split/merge/repack/process/return cannot destroy provenance.
invariants.proof: tests/node/sw0-11.test.mjs — transformations preserve explicit input/output lot ancestry and conservation evidence; broader durable ancestry persistence remains pending

invariants.rule: Unavailable/unsafe/held quantity cannot become available merely through allocation or projection.
invariants.proof: tests/node/sw0-06.test.mjs + tests/node/sw0-10.test.mjs — quarantined/rejected lots remain unavailable in canonical allocation and rebuilt inventory views

invariants.rule: Ownership, possession, custody, control, allocation and encumbrance remain distinguishable.
invariants.proof: packages/inventory + tests/node/sw0-06.test.mjs + tests/node/sw0-07b.test.mjs + tests/node/sw0-11.test.mjs — ownership/custody/allocation remain distinct and active security claims reduce disposable quantity

invariants.rule: Reserve is a governed designation; release obeys authority and constraints.
invariants.proof: tests/node/sw0-11.test.mjs — reserve designation carries purpose/policy/evidence and release is blocked by retained floor/coverage constraints

invariants.rule: No single universal cost field may substitute for purpose-specific cost basis.
invariants.proof: tests/node/sw0-09.test.mjs — fulfilled-member cost basis declares purpose, method version and evidence-backed cost components rather than a universal cost scalar

invariants.rule: Savings require a valid comparable governed benchmark and may be zero/negative.
invariants.proof: tests/node/sw0-09.test.mjs — savings requires versioned executable comparable benchmark, actual member economics and mandatory charges; zero/negative values remain ledger-visible

invariants.rule: Subsidy/promotion/cross-subsidy cannot masquerade as structural advantage.
invariants.proof: tests/node/sw0-09.test.mjs — support is separately classified and excluded from risk-adjusted structural-advantage calculation; FX-015 prevents supplier-promo laundering

invariants.rule: Any future price promise is bounded by spec, quantity, place, time, rule, conditions and authority.
invariants.proof: tests/node/sw0-11.test.mjs — price promises require specification, positive quantity, place, validity window, rule version, conditions, authority and evidence

invariants.rule: Positive expected return cannot justify an action that violates hard liquidity/solvency constraints.
invariants.proof: tests/node/sw0-11.test.mjs — capital action is rejected when deployable liquidity/headroom or maturity constraints fail regardless of expected return

invariants.rule: Security interests/restrictions remain visible to any disposition/availability decision.
invariants.proof: tests/node/sw0-11.test.mjs — active security interests explicitly reduce disposable lot quantity

invariants.rule: No unauthorized double pledge or double representation of unencumbered collateral capacity.
invariants.proof: tests/node/sw0-11.test.mjs — cumulative active pledges cannot exceed lot quantity and second conflicting pledge is rejected

invariants.rule: Possession, custody, title, risk, acceptance, settlement and discharge are orthogonal.
invariants.proof: tests/node/sw0-07.test.mjs + tests/node/sw0-08.test.mjs — handover, acceptance, performed quantity, remedy settlement and completion remain separately represented; title/risk remain pending

invariants.rule: Only actually conforming performed quantity is discharged.
invariants.proof: tests/node/sw0-07.test.mjs + tests/node/sw0-08.test.mjs — partial/rejected performance cannot become delivered completion; remedies resolve separately without relabeling delivery

invariants.rule: Material substitution preserves original promise, equivalence/consent and economic recomputation.
invariants.proof: tests/node/sw0-08.test.mjs — material substitution retains original specification, requires equivalence evidence, member consent and economic recomputation before remedy resolution

invariants.rule: Returned goods do not re-enter availability without governed quality-state determination.
invariants.proof: tests/node/sw0-11.test.mjs — returned lot remains unavailable until ACCEPTED quality state plus quality evidence exists

invariants.rule: Observation/assertion/inference/model output remain distinguishable.
invariants.proof: tests/node/sw0-11.test.mjs — governed evidence preserves explicit epistemic kind and model output is not upgraded to observation

invariants.rule: Corrections/reversals/restatements are additive/versioned; history is not silently rewritten.
invariants.proof: tests/node/kernel.test.mjs + tests/node/sw0-09.test.mjs + tests/node/sw0-10.test.mjs — canonical/savings correction history remains additive while projections rebuild to latest governed view

invariants.rule: Material contradictory evidence is preserved and surfaced until governed resolution.
invariants.proof: tests/node/sw0-11.test.mjs — contradiction records remain OPEN unless explicit resolution evidence is supplied

invariants.rule: Material decisions preserve model version, inputs, assumptions and authority envelope.
invariants.proof: tests/node/sw0-11.test.mjs — material decision record requires objective, model version, inputs, assumptions, authority, alternatives, constraints, time and evidence

invariants.rule: Retries cannot duplicate economic/physical effect.
invariants.proof: tests/node/kernel.test.mjs + tests/node/sw0-07b.test.mjs + tests/node/sw0-08.test.mjs — accepted, domain-rejected and refund-remedy retries are effect-idempotent in memory; durable persistence adapter remains pending

invariants.rule: Stale concurrent commands cannot silently violate allocation, quantity, authority or exposure limits.
invariants.proof: tests/node/kernel.test.mjs — expectedVersion stale command rejection; database serialization proof pending

invariants.rule: Read-model failure/staleness cannot corrupt canonical history; material views disclose freshness/lineage.
invariants.proof: tests/node/sw0-10.test.mjs — member, inventory, fulfillment and savings views drop/rebuild equivalently from canonical records, expose checkpoints/source lineage, detect stale views and cannot mutate the canonical log

invariants.rule: Implementation cannot amend canon by schema, default, status field or repeated practice.
invariants.proof: SW0-07A + scripts/check-canon.mjs + scripts/check-traceability.mjs — invariant text/status binding and cumulative traceability drift are now automatically checked
